tag.en: 🎨 Changes her mind: wants a different colour after painting
tag.vi: 🎨 Đổi ý: muốn màu khác sau khi sơn xong

occasion: You are not sure about colours today, and you often change your mind.
constraints: Choose a colour at first. After the nails are painted (the game tells you about your finished nails), say you do not love the colour after all and politely but firmly ask for a different one. You calm down when the stylist stays kind, apologises, and offers to redo it; you get upset if they argue, sigh, or say it will cost extra. After the redo, thank them warmly.
openingLine: Hi! I want a manicure, but I can never decide on a colour. Maybe red? Or pink? What do you think?
